name: live-v8-memory-decisions
objective: v2.3 replan V8, on the real host: a Discard clicked in the reconciliation panel is written to the chat (the row leaves the store AND the saved metadata, and its text is excluded), and a manual edit stores the exact count from ST's own tokenizer and marks the text as the author's. Extraction is planted on purpose: neither decision consumes a model, and the facts must share one source message so a single edit quarantines both.

requires.why: facts are planted through a mocked read on purpose (the subject is the queue/quarantine, not extraction); judge memoryVerify (on by default since v2.6 rule 5) drops planted lines the transcript does not support, so on a judge-on lane they never land (green x2 on the judge-off no-model lane, T7 SUITE)

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0 }); globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; return { cadence: 0 };

steps.send: I shoulder past the drinkers and read the postings on the board.

extract.debugResponse:
FACT importance=2 text="A ferryman at the board offers a crossing for a debt." evidence="I shoulder past the drinkers and read the postings on the board."
FACT importance=2 text="The Sun Ruins posting promises a sealed door under the sand." evidence="I shoulder past the drinkers and read the postings on the board."

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const facts = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.filter((entry) => entry.tier === 'facts'); const discard = facts.find((entry) => entry.text.includes('ferryman')); const keep = facts.find((entry) => entry.text.includes('sealed door')); if (!discard || !keep) throw new Error(`the planted facts did not land: ${JSON.stringify(facts.map((entry) => entry.text))}`); const last = rt.getEngineState().lastMessageId; if (discard.messageId !== last || keep.messageId !== last) throw new Error(`both facts must come from the engine's last message ${last}: ${discard.messageId}, ${keep.messageId}`); if (facts.indexOf(discard) > facts.indexOf(keep)) throw new Error('the discard target must be the first quarantined row'); await rt.setMemoryPinned(discard.id, true); await rt.setMemoryPinned(keep.id, true); globalThis.__v8Discard = discard.id; globalThis.__v8Keep = keep.id; globalThis.__v8DiscardText = discard.text; return { discard: discard.id, keep: keep.id, sourceMessageId: last };

edit.text: I read only the shipping notices and leave the postings alone.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const rows = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.filter((entry) => [globalThis.__v8Discard, globalThis.__v8Keep].includes(entry.id)); if (rows.length !== 2 || rows.some((row) => row.provenance?.validity !== 'source-removed')) throw new Error(`the edit did not quarantine both pinned facts: ${JSON.stringify(rows.map((row) => [row.text, row.provenance?.validity]))}`); return rows.map((row) => row.provenance.validity);

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500)); const memory = rt.getSnapshot().memory; if (memory.entries.some((entry) => entry.id === globalThis.__v8Discard)) throw new Error('the discarded row is still in the store'); if (!memory.entries.some((entry) => entry.id === globalThis.__v8Keep)) throw new Error('the discard took the wrong row: the other quarantined fact is gone'); if (document.querySelector('[data-so="decision-refused"]')) throw new Error('the panel says the discard was not written'); const blob = ctx.chatMetadata?.story_orchestrator; const savedEntries = blob?.stories?.[blob?.selectedStoryId]?.extras?.memory?.entries; if (!Array.isArray(savedEntries)) throw new Error(`no saved memory entries at stories[${blob?.selectedStoryId}].extras.memory.entries`); if (savedEntries.some((entry) => entry.id === globalThis.__v8Discard)) throw new Error('the discarded row is still in the saved memory entries'); if (!savedEntries.some((entry) => entry.id === globalThis.__v8Keep)) throw new Error('the kept row is missing from the saved memory entries'); const exclusion = (memory.derived ?? []).find((record) => record.kind === 'exclusion' && record.inputs?.includes(globalThis.__v8Discard)); if (!exclusion) throw new Error('the discard recorded no exclusion, so a rollback past it cannot restore the row'); return { gone: true, savedWithout: true, exclusion: exclusion.id, saveHealth: rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth ?? null };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const text = 'The Sun Ruins posting, as the author corrects it, promises a sealed bronze door buried under the western dunes, guarded by the old wardens.'; await rt.editMemoryEntry(globalThis.__v8Keep, text); const expected = await ctx.getTokenCountAsync(text); const row = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.find((entry) => entry.id === globalThis.__v8Keep); if (!row) throw new Error('the edited row is gone'); if (row.text !== text) throw new Error(`the edit did not land: ${row.text}`); if (typeof row.tokens !== 'number') throw new Error(`the exact token count was never stored (M7): tokens=${row.tokens}`); if (row.tokens !== expected) throw new Error(`stored ${row.tokens} tokens, ST's tokenizer says ${expected}`); if (row.provenance?.source !== 'author' || row.provenance?.override?.from !== 'edit' || row.provenance?.validity !== 'live') throw new Error(`the edit is not recorded as the author's claim: ${JSON.stringify(row.provenance)}`); const blob = ctx.chatMetadata?.story_orchestrator; const savedRow = (blob?.stories?.[blob?.selectedStoryId]?.extras?.memory?.entries ?? []).find((entry) => entry.id === globalThis.__v8Keep); if (savedRow?.text !== text || savedRow?.provenance?.override?.from !== 'edit') throw new Error(`the saved row does not carry the edit: ${JSON.stringify(savedRow?.provenance)}`); return { tokens: row.tokens, expected, provenance: row.provenance };
